mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of instances during monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS decline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates improving labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 4.5% but 5d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand (GDPC1) and demand-driven inflation (RSAFS) above critical thresholds signal robust economic activity, prompting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS above thresholds but 20d returns not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS rise but 20d returns remain non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent monthly declines in unemployment (PAYEMS) below historical levels indicate strengthening labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS decline for 6 months but 60d returns not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the supply index (INDPRO) below 100 suggests reduced production capacity, triggering positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
Both rising GDP (GDPC1) and industrial output (HOUST) above their 5-month moving averages signal robust demand, prompting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST above thresholds but 20d returns not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession recovery phase, a decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals policy easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In recession recovery phase, FEDFUNDS fall but 60d returns not positive.
